549.name: Pure of Heart
549.description: Aegis heals when it blocks an attack.

551.name: Selfless Daring
551.description: The end of your dodge roll heals nearby allies.

553.name: Pure of Voice
553.description: <c=@abilitytype>Shout</c> skills convert conditions to boons on allies.

554.name: Battle Presence
554.description:
Nearby allies gain the passive effect of Virtue skill 2.

Willbender: Heal allies when your Resolve effect triggers.

557.name: Honorable Staff
557.description: Gain concentration. Empower now grants endurance to allies in addition to its effects. Staff skills recharge time is reduced.

559.name: Protective Reviver
559.description: Cast Lesser Shield of Absorption when you begin reviving an ally. Shield of Absorption revives allies when it detonates.

562.name: Empowering Might
562.description: Grant might to nearby allies when you critically strike.

563.name: Wrathful Spirit
563.description: Aegis grants boons when it ends.

564.name: Vigorous Precision
564.description: Gain vigor at the end of your dodge roll.

565.name: Retribution
565.description: Strike damage dealt is increased while you have resolution.

566.name: Right-Hand Strength
566.description: Your precision is increased. Gain increased power while wielding a one-handed weapon in your main hand.

567.name: Radiant Fire
567.description: Zealot's Flame is improved. Burning you inflict has increased duration, and your torch skills gain reduced recharge.

568.name: Radiant Power
568.description: Attacks against burning foes have an increased chance to critically hit. Your ferocity is increased.

571.name: Renewed Justice
571.description: Virtue skill 1 is renewed when you kill a foe.

572.name: Justice is Blind
572.description: Gain a light aura and blind nearby foes when you activate Virtue skill 1.

574.name: Healer's Resolution
574.description: Gain resolution when using a heal skill.

577.name: Inner Fire
577.description: Gain fury when you strike a foe that has burning stacks over the threshold.

578.name: Wrath of Justice
578.description: Striking an enemy with the damaging effect from Virtue skill 1 casts Lesser Signet of Wrath.

579.name: Perfect Inscriptions
579.description: <c=@abilitytype>Signets</c> gain improved passive effects and continue to grant their passive bonuses while recharging.

580.name: Stalwart Defender
580.description: Gain toughness when wielding a shield, and shield skills gain reduced recharge.

581.name: Smiter's Boon
581.description: Cast Lesser Smite Condition when you use a healing skill.

582.name: Valorous Defense
582.description: Gain aegis when you are struck while below the health threshold.

583.name: Might of the Protector
583.description: Gain might when you block attacks.

584.name: Redemption
584.description: Cast Lesser Litany of Wrath when you activate Virtue skill 3.

585.name: Altruistic Healing
585.description: Heal yourself when you grant a boon to an ally.

586.name: Monk's Focus
586.description: <c=@abilitytype>Meditation</c> skills heal you and grant fury to nearby allies.

587.name: Glacial Heart
587.description:
Mighty Blow becomes Glacial Blow. Heal when you disable, immobilize, or chill a foe.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

588.name: Strength of the Fallen
588.description: Lose conditions every interval. Health degenerates more slowly while downed.

589.name: Tenacious Defense
589.description: Aegis you grant reduces the recharge time of Virtue skill 3 when it blocks an attack.

594.name: Steadfast Courage
594.description: Gain protection when you block an incoming attack with aegis.

603.name: Inspiring Virtue
603.description: Strike damage dealt is increased after activating a virtue.

604.name: Virtue of Resolution
604.description: Gain resolution when you activate a <c=@abilitytype>Virtue</c>. Resolution you grant has increased duration.

610.name: Absolute Resolve
610.description: Activating Virtue skill 2 removes conditions from nearby allies. Virtue skill 2's passive effect is stronger.

612.name: Indomitable Courage
612.description: The active effect of Virtue skill 3 breaks stun and grants stability to nearby allies. Its passive effect gains a shorter interval.

620.name: Power of the Virtuous
620.description: Gain condition damage based on your vitality. <c=@abilitytype>Virtues</c> gain reduced recharge.

621.name: Inspired Virtue
621.description: <c=@abilitytype>Virtues</c> apply boons to allies when activated. Deal increased strike damage for each boon on you.

622.name: Permeating Wrath
622.description: The passive effect of Virtue skill 1 triggers more quickly and now burns in an area.

624.name: Unscathed Contender
624.description: Strike damage dealt is increased while you have aegis. Strike damage dealt is increased while you are above the health threshold.

625.name: Resolute Subconscious
625.description:
Gain resolution and aegis when disabled.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

628.name: Renewing Splendor
628.description:
Heal yourself when you create a light field or finish a combo in a light field.
Whirl finishers can only trigger this trait once per interval.

633.name: Focus Mastery
633.description: Focus skills grant you protection and gain reduced recharge.

634.name: Fiery Wrath
634.description: Deal increased strike damage to burning foes.

635.name: Eternal Armory
635.description: <c=@abilitytype>Spirit Weapons</c> gain additional casts and burn foes with their first strike.

637.name: Shattered Aegis
637.description: When an aegis you applied blocks an attack, it unleashes a Mystic Rebuke.

646.name: Symbolic Exposure
646.description: <c=@abilitytype>Symbols</c> inflict vulnerability on foes. Deal increased strike damage to vulnerable foes.

648.name: Zealot's Resolution
648.description: Cast Lesser Symbol of Resolution when you strike an enemy below the health threshold.

649.name: Symbolic Avenger
649.description: Your strike damage is increased whenever your <c=@abilitytype>Symbols</c> hit a foe.

653.name: Zealous Blade
653.description: Your power is increased. Gain additional power while wielding a greatsword. Your greatsword skills have reduced recharge.

654.name: Protector's Restoration
654.description: Cast Lesser Symbol of Protection when you use a healing skill.

1556.name: Kindled Zeal
1556.description: Gain condition damage based on your power.

1682.name: Force of Will
1682.description: Gain increased vitality. Healing others is improved based on a percentage of your vitality.

1683.name: Righteous Instincts
1683.description: Resolution increases your chances to critically strike and grants might each interval.

1684.name: Communal Defenses
1684.description: Blocking an attack grants aegis to nearby allies.

1685.name: Purity of Body
1685.description: Your Virtue skill 2 passive also regenerates endurance.

1686.name: Amplified Wrath
1686.description: Burning you inflict deals increased damage. Burning duration applied by the passive effect of Virtue skill 1 is increased.

1835.name: Zealot's Aggression
1835.description: Deal increased strike damage to crippled foes. Justice's passive effect cripples enemies.

1848.name: Virtuous Action
1848.description: The guardian's resolve has further increased, allowing <c=@abilitytype>Virtues</c> to be manifested as physical aspects. Gain access to <c=@abilitytype>Traps</c>.

1896.name: Defender's Dogma
1896.description: Gain vitality. Blocking an attack causes Justice to reach its maximum charge and reduces the cooldown of Spear of Justice.

1899.name: Invigorated Bulwark
1899.description: Increase your healing to other allies each time you block an attack. Mace skills gain reduced recharge and their boons gain increased duration.

1908.name: Hunter's Fortification
1908.description: Remove conditions and heal when blocking or evading attacks. <c=@reminder>Block and evade triggers have separate cooldowns.</c>

1911.name: Soaring Devastation
1911.description: Wings of Resolve delivers an attack upon landing. Movement speed is increased.

1925.name: Zealous Scepter
1925.description: Gain might when your Virtue skill 1 passive effect triggers; gain more might while wielding a scepter.

1926.name: Pure of Sight
1926.description: Deal bonus strike damage based on your distance to the enemy.

1943.name: Bulwark
1943.description: Shield of Courage gains increased radius and duration.

1955.name: Big Game Hunter
1955.description: Striking an enemy tethered by your Spear of Justice inflicts vulnerability and increases strike damage dealt. Tether duration is increased.

1963.name: Heavy Light
1963.description:
Gain stability when disabling an enemy. Deal increased strike damage to disabled, exposed, or defiant foes.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

1983.name: Dulled Senses
1983.description:
Cripple enemies that you disable.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

2017.name: Furious Focus
2017.description: Your strike damage and movement speed are increased while you have fury. Create a Lesser Symbol of Blades when you activate Virtue skill 1.

2037.name: Hunter's Determination
2037.description: Activating your elite skill breaks stuns and grants you endurance.

2062.name: Swift Scholar
2062.description:
Equipping a Virtue grants you quickness. Every third Tome skill grants you pages.
Stacks reset when exiting a tome.
Quickness can only be gained once per interval

2063.name: Weighty Terms
2063.description: The final charge of your <c=@abilitytype>Mantra</c> skills will slow nearby foes and grant you pages.

2075.name: Unrelenting Criticism
2075.description: Axe skills gain a chance to inflict bleeding.

2076.name: Stalwart Speed
2076.description:
When you grant aegis or stability, grant quickness.
This can affect multiple targets simultaneously.

2089.name: Purity of Word
2089.description:
Gain knowledge of Elonian lore, igniting a fierce drive to purge corruption and manifesting your Virtues as mystic tomes. Gain access to Mantras.
Using Tome skills consumes pages. You regenerate pages every interval.

2101.name: Liberator's Vow
2101.description: Grant allies quickness when you use your heal skill.

2105.name: Stoic Demeanor
2105.description:
Retain Courage passive while it is on cooldown. Grant boons to nearby allies when you disable, immobilize, or slow an enemy.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, launch, taunt, and fear.

2116.name: Legendary Lore
2116.description: <c=@abilitytype>Tome</c> skills gain bonuses from scribbling in the margins by ancient bards.

2148.name: Imbued Haste
2148.description: Gain increased attributes while affected by quickness.

2159.name: Loremaster
2159.description: Retain <c=@abilitytype>Resolve</c> passive while it is on cooldown. You generate pages more quickly.

2179.name: Quickfire
2179.description: Retain <c=@abilitytype>Justice</c> passive while it is on cooldown. Granting quickness to an ally also grants Ashes of the Just.

2187.name: Conceited Curate
2187.description: Gain increased vitality. <c=@abilitytype>Willbender Flames</c> now heal you when they strike an enemy.

2189.name: Lethal Tempo
2189.description: Each time you activate a virtue or your virtue's passives are triggered, gain a damage bonus. Gaining stacks of this boon refreshes other stacks.

2190.name: Power for Power
2190.description: Gain increased power. <c=@abilitytype>Willbender Flames</c> deal increased damage to foes they strike.

2191.name: Searing Pact
2191.description: Gain condition damage. <c=@abilitytype>Willbender Flames</c> now inflict burning on foes they strike.

2195.name: Phoenix Protocol
2195.description: Gain boons when resolve's effect triggers, but you no longer heal. Resolve has a modified duration. Gain boons when you use Flowing Resolve.

2197.name: Restorative Virtues
2197.description: Triggered virtue effects reduce the cooldown of active weapon abilities. Gain vigor when activating Flowing Resolve.

2198.name: Deathless Courage
2198.description: While Courage is active, incoming strike damage and condition damage is reduced.

2199.name: Vanguard Tactics
2199.description: Activating Crashing Courage grants resistance. Shadowstepping grants resolution and protection.

2200.name: Willbender Training
2200.description: The guardian's Virtues are now movement based, giving them a swift advantage in combat. Gain access to the Physical skill type.

2201.name: Tyrant's Momentum
2201.description: Lethal Tempo grants increased damage, but has reduced duration. Justice's duration is modified.

2210.name: Holy Reckoning
2210.description: Triggered virtue effects now grant might to allies in addition to their bonuses. Gain fury when activating Rushing Justice.

2222.name: Righteous Sprint
2222.description: Gain increased movement speed. Gain swiftness when you activate a virtue.

2328.name: Sovereign of Light
2328.description: Gain light aura when entering Radiant Forge. Luminary skills detonate light aura, damaging enemies and healing allies.

2329.name: Persistent Blessing
2329.description: Refresh the duration of your Luminary's Blessing and trigger its healing when you exit Radiant Forge.

2330.name: Resplendent Weaponry
2330.description: Grant boons to nearby allies when you equip a radiant weapon.

2368.name: Illuminating Inspiration
2368.description: Reduce the recharge of your <c=@abilitytype>virtue</c> skills when you equip a radiant weapon.

2381.name: Luminary
2381.description: Harness light and flame to bolster yourself and allies or disrupt your enemies. Gain access to Radiant Forge and <c=@abilitytype>stance</c> skills.

2388.name: Master-at-Arms
2388.description: Using a <c=@abilitytype>virtue</c> skill recharges radiant weapon skills. Justice recharges hammer, Resolve recharges staff, and Courage recharges sword and shield.

2394.name: Light's Gift
2394.description: Gain vitality. Grant Luminary's Blessing to allies when you equip a radiant weapon.

2401.name: Purging Light
2401.description: Remove conditions from nearby allies when you grant yourself light aura. Gain light aura when you use a healing skill.

2410.name: Shimmering Stances
2410.description: <c=@abilitytype>Stances</c> grant protection to affected allies and blind affected enemies.

2417.name: Resolute Blessing
2417.description: Luminary's Blessing now also reduces incoming condition damage.

2419.name: Empowered Armaments
2419.description: Gain increased strike damage when you equip a radiant weapon.

2435.name: Radiant Armaments
2435.description: Gain a bonus based on your equipped radiant weapon. This bonus lingers for a period of time after exiting Radiant Forge.

9080.name: Leap of Faith
9080.description: Leap at your foe. Inflicts blindness and heals you for each foe hit. Heal for a lesser amount for each target struck beyond the first.

9081.name: Whirling Wrath
9081.description: Spin in place and swing your greatsword while hurling powerful projectiles.

9082.name: Shield of Wrath
9082.description: Create a shield to block the next three attacks. If the shield is not destroyed, it explodes and damages nearby foes.

9083.name: "Receive the Light!"
9083.description: Shout. Heal yourself and allies in a cone in front of you.

9084.name: "Advance!"
9084.description: Shout. Grant aegis and swiftness to up to five nearby allies.

9085.name: "Save Yourselves!"
9085.description: Shout. Draw conditions from nearby allies to yourself. Gain multiple boons for a short duration.

9086.name: Protector's Strike
9086.description: Protect allies from the next incoming attack against them, and lash out when attacked, granting boons to nearby allies and fully charging the passive burning effect.

9087.name: Shield of Judgment
9087.description: Create a shielding wave in front of you that damages foes while giving protection and aegis to you and up to five allies.

9088.name: Cleansing Flame
9088.description: Remove conditions from yourself then breathe magical flames that damage foes and cure conditions on allies. Inflicts burning on the final attack.

9089.name: Zealot's Fire
9089.description: Throw your Zealot's Flame to damage the targeted foe.

9090.name: Symbol of Punishment
9090.description: Symbol. Create a symbol on the ground that strikes foes and grants might to nearby allies.

9091.name: Shield of Absorption
9091.description: Create a dome around you that pushes foes back and absorbs projectiles.

9093.name: Bane Signet
9093.description:
Signet Passive: Improved Power
Signet Active: Knock down and damage your foe.

9097.name: Symbol of Blades
9097.description: Symbol. Teleport to your target, and blind nearby foes. Create a symbol at your feet that damages nearby enemies and benefits allies.

9098.name: Orb of Wrath
9098.description: Fire a slow-moving orb at your foe.

9099.name: Chains of Light
9099.description: Immobilize and make your foe vulnerable with ethereal chains.

9101.name: Lesser Smite Condition
9101.description: Meditation. Cure conditions and damage nearby foes. Deal more damage if a condition is cured.

9104.name: Zealot's Flame
9104.description: Set yourself alight, periodically burning up to three nearby foes. The final pulse applies additional burning.

9107.name: Zealot's Defense
9107.description: Block ranged attacks while casting magical projectiles.

9108.name: Faithful Strike
9108.description: Hit your foe with a final strike and heal nearby allies.

9111.name: Symbol of Faith
9111.description: Symbol. Smash the ground to heal allies and create a mystic symbol that damages foes and regenerates allies.

9112.name: Ray of Judgment
9112.description: Purge the target area in a ray of light. Allies are healed and cleansed of a condition, while enemies are infused with blinding light, taking damage each interval if they are initially struck.

9115.name: Virtue of Justice
9115.description:
Virtue: Burn foes every few attacks.
Activate: You and your allies inflict burning on the next attack.

9118.name: Virtue of Courage
9118.description:
Virtue: Gain aegis periodically.
Activate: Grant aegis to yourself and nearby allies.

9120.name: Virtue of Resolve
9120.description:
Virtue: Regenerates health.
Activate: Heal yourself and nearby allies.

9122.name: Bolt of Wrath
9122.description: Fire a bolt that damages foes.

9124.name: Banish
9124.description: Launch your foe with a powerful smash. Striking a foe refreshes Mighty Blow and allows your next Mighty Blow to teleport to that foe.

9125.name: Hammer of Wisdom
9125.description: Spirit Weapon. Order the Hammer of Wisdom to knock down your foe.

9128.name: Sanctuary
9128.description: Consecration. Form a protective healing shelter for allies. Block foes and their missiles from entering.

9139.name: Wrathful Strike
9139.description: Attack with a final, powerful strike that applies might for each foe you strike.

9140.name: Holy Strike
9140.description: Mark an area for judgment, rapidly healing allies and then blasting foes in the area.

9143.name: Symbol of Swiftness
9143.description: Symbol. Sear a mystic symbol into the target area, damaging foes and granting swiftness to allies. Allies in the area gain a burst of speed when the symbol is created.

9144.name: Line of Warding
9144.description: Ward. Create a line in front of you that foes cannot cross.

9146.name: Symbol of Resolution
9146.description: Symbol. Pierce the ground with a mystic symbol that damages foes while granting resolution to allies.

9147.name: Binding Blade
9147.description: Throw blades at your foes, causing damage over time. Bound foes can be pulled to you. The effect ends when a foe moves out of range.

9150.name: Signet of Judgment
9150.description:
Signet Passive: Reduces all incoming damage.
Signet Active: Grant resolution and protection to nearby allies while debilitating nearby enemies.

9151.name: Signet of Wrath
9151.description:
Signet Passive: Grants you increased condition damage.
Signet Active: Immobilize and burn your target.

9152.name: "Hold the Line!"
9152.description: Shout. Grant protection and regeneration to allies.

9153.name: "Stand Your Ground!"
9153.description: Shout. Grant stability to yourself and allies.

9154.name: Renewed Focus
9154.description: Meditation. Focus, making yourself invulnerable and recharging your virtues.

9158.name: Signet of Resolve
9158.description:
Signet Passive: Remove a condition from yourself every few seconds.
Signet Active: Heal yourself and remove conditions.

9161.name: Symbol of Protection
9161.description: Symbol. Smash a mystic symbol onto the ground that gives protection to you and your allies.

9163.name: Signet of Mercy
9163.description:
Signet Passive: Improves concentration.
Signet Active: Revive a nearby downed ally.

9168.name: Sword of Justice
9168.description: Spirit Weapon. Will the Sword of Justice to appear beside your enemy and attack nearby foes.

9175.name: Bow of Truth
9175.description: Spirit Weapon. Command the Bow of Truth to barrage a location with healing arrows.

9182.name: Shield of the Avenger
9182.description: Spirit Weapon. Command the Shield of the Avenger to form a protective dome, and then shatter, flying out to weaken nearby foes.

9187.name: Purging Flames
9187.description: Consecration. Create a ring of fire. With each pulse, burn foes while removing conditions from allies inside the area of effect.

9189.name: Spear of Light
9189.description: Throw a spear that makes your foe vulnerable, dealing bonus damage at closer range.

9190.name: Zealot's Flurry
9190.description: Strike foes in front of you with a storm of jabs.

9192.name: Symbol of Spears
9192.description: Symbol. Create a spear wall in front of you that damages foes that remain in its area.

9193.name: Wrathful Grasp
9193.description: Throw a spear and pull your foe to you, burning them.

9194.name: Mighty Blow
9194.description: Damage nearby foes with a mighty ground slam. If your target has been struck by Banish, teleport to them.

9195.name: Ring of Warding
9195.description: Ward. Create a ring around you that foes cannot cross. Trapped foes cannot exit the ring while it is active.

9205.name: Light Ball
9205.description: Fire a sundering ball of light that damages foes.

9206.name: Weight of Justice
9206.description:
Sink your foe with the weight of justice, inflicting damage continuously. 
Damage ceases if the stun is broken.

9207.name: Purify
9207.description: Release an orb of cleansing light that cures conditions on allies it passes through and detonates on enemies struck. Burns foes and cures conditions on allies within the blast radius.

9208.name: Symbol of Light
9208.description: Symbol. Create a pillar of light that does damage every second at your foe's location.

9209.name: Refraction
9209.description: Create a bubble that blocks enemy missiles and grants resolution to allies.

9224.name: Shield of Absorption
9224.description: Detonate the dome to heal nearby allies.

9227.name: Sword Wave
9227.description: Send out waves of attacks that strike multiple targets.

9234.name: Purifying Blast
9234.description: Detonate the orb to burn foes and cure conditions on allies in the blast radius.

9245.name: Smite Condition
9245.description: Meditation. Cure conditions and damage nearby foes. Deal more damage if a condition is cured.

9246.name: Merciful Intervention
9246.description: Meditation. Shadowstep to an ally in the targeted area and heal around them. If no ally is present in the targeted area, this ability will not shadowstep.

9247.name: Judge's Intervention
9247.description: Meditation. Teleport to your target and burn nearby foes.

9248.name: Contemplation of Purity
9248.description: Meditation. Convert the conditions you are suffering from into boons.

9250.name: Virtue of Resolve
9250.description:
Virtue: Regenerates health.
Activate: Heal yourself and nearby allies.

9251.name: Wall of Reflection
9251.description: Consecration. Summon a barrier of mystic power that reflects projectiles.

9253.name: Hallowed Ground
9253.description: Consecration. Consecrate the target area, granting stability to allies inside.

9260.name: Zealot's Embrace
9260.description: Send a wave toward your foe that immobilizes foes in a line. Gain barrier for each target struck. Barrier is reduced for each target struck beyond the first.

9265.name: Empower
9265.description: Channel healing and might to nearby allies. Completing this channel grants more health to your allies.

9268.name: Virtue of Courage
9268.description:
Virtue: Gain aegis periodically.
Activate: Grant aegis to yourself and nearby allies.

13677.name: Lesser Symbol of Resolution
13677.description: Symbol. Sear a mystic symbol into the target area, damaging foes and granting resolution to allies.

13684.name: Lesser Symbol of Protection
13684.description: Symbol. Create a symbol that gives protection to you and your allies.

13688.name: Lesser Shield of Absorption
13688.description: Create a dome around you that pushes foes back and absorbs projectiles. After a duration, it detonates, healing nearby allies.

15834.name: Shield of Judgment
15834.description: Create a shielding wave in front of you that damages foes while giving protection and aegis to you and up to five allies.

21664.name: Litany of Wrath
21664.description: Meditation. Heal yourself. For a brief time, heal yourself based on a percentage of damage dealt to enemies.

29630.name: Deflecting Shot
29630.description: Fire a missile that knocks back enemies and blocks missiles.

29786.name: Test of Faith
29786.description: Trap. Lay a trap that creates a ring of weapons that punishes enemies that attempt to cross their threshold. Passthrough damage is increased against disabled targets.

29789.name: Symbol of Energy
29789.description: Symbol. Fire a slow, arcing arrow that explodes on impact to burn targets and sear a symbol of energy into the ground.

29887.name: Spear of Justice
29887.description:
Virtue. Burn foes every few attacks.
Activate: Hurl a spear of light that passes through foes. Enemies struck become tethered and receive conditions periodically.

29965.name: "Feel My Wrath!"
29965.description: Shout. Grant fury and quickness to nearby allies. The duration of the quickness you grant yourself is doubled.

30025.name: Purification
30025.description: Trap. Heal yourself and imbue your light into a trap. Enemies that trigger this trap are damaged and blinded as the light returns to you for a second heal.

30029.name: Shield of Courage
30029.description:
Virtue. Grants aegis periodically.
Activate: Grant aegis to nearby allies and create a shield in front of you that blocks attacks. You are vulnerable from the sides and behind while this shield is active.

30039.name: Shield of Courage
30039.description:
Virtue. Grants aegis periodically.
Activate: Grant aegis to nearby allies and create a shield in front of you that blocks attacks. You are vulnerable from the sides and behind while this shield is active.

30225.name: Wings of Resolve
30225.description:
Virtue: Regenerates health.
Activate: Leap to a target area, healing allies in the area.

30229.name: True Shot
30229.description: Charge up energy, creating a powerful attack that pierces through enemies.

30273.name: Dragon's Maw
30273.description: Trap. Lay a trap that pulls enemies and creates a barrier that holds them in.

30364.name: Procession of Blades
30364.description: Trap. Set a trap that whirls around and damages enemies when activated.

30461.name: Signet of Courage
30461.description:
Signet Passive: Periodically heal allies in an area around you while in combat.
Signet Active: Channel healing and boons in a large area around you, concluding with a large heal if this skill is not interrupted.

30471.name: Puncture Shot
30471.description: Fire an arrow that pierces enemies. If the arrow hits a second target, all enemies struck are crippled.

30553.name: Fragments of Faith
30553.description: Trap. Lay a trap that deals damage and unleashes multiple fragments into the area when triggered. Each fragment grants aegis to allies, as long as they don't already have aegis.

30628.name: Hunter's Ward
30628.description: Form your arrows into a barrier, and deal damage at the location.

30783.name: Wings of Resolve
30783.description:
Virtue: Regenerates health.
Activate: Leap to a target area, healing allies in the area.

30871.name: Light's Judgment
30871.description: Trap. Lay down a trap that creates an area of pure light that reveals enemies and pierces their armor. The first strike dazes foes.

33134.name: Hunter's Verdict
33134.description: Pull all enemies tethered by the Spear of Justice to you, breaking the link. This ability's recharge is separate from that of Spear of Justice.

40114.name: Portent of Freedom
40114.description: Hints of freedom echo around, stabilizing and breaking stuns on you and your allies.

40624.name: Symbol of Vengeance
40624.description: Symbol. Cleave your axe into the ground, reducing enemy movement and carving a razor-sharp symbol of vengeance.

40915.name: Mantra of Potence
40915.description:
Mantra. Recite a hymn from the annals of Turai to quicken yourself and your allies.
The final charge of this skill is more powerful.

41475.name: Restoring Reprieve
41475.description: Gain health. Grant boons to yourself and allies in front of and around you.

41571.name: Shield of the Avenger
41571.description: Spirit Weapon. Command the Shield of the Avenger to form a protective dome, and then shatter, flying out to weaken nearby foes.

41714.name: Mantra of Solace
41714.description:
Mantra. Prepare to heal yourself and grant boons to allies. 
The final charge of this skill is more powerful.

41780.name: Tome of Resolve
41780.description:
Virtue: Regenerate health.
Activate: Draw forth an enchanted tome that recounts the trials undergone by the people of Vabbi.

41988.name: Overwhelming Celerity
41988.description: Final Charge. Inspire allies before and beside you, greatly enhancing their speed and strength.

42259.name: Tome of Courage
42259.description:
Virtue: Gain aegis periodically. 
Activate: Conjure a mystic tome containing stories about the heroes of Istan.

42360.name: Echo of Truth
42360.description: Recount a truth to enemies in front of and around you, inflicting them with conditions.

42371.name: Tome of Courage
42371.description:
Virtue: Gain aegis periodically. 
Activate: Conjure a mystic tome containing stories about the heroes of Istan.

42864.name: Opening Passage
42864.description: Recite a cleansing word, purifying allies of conditions and helping them recover.

42983.name: Potent Haste
42983.description: Inspire allies before and beside you, enhancing their speed and strength.

43357.name: Mantra of Liberation
43357.description:
Mantra. Echo remnants of an ancient pamphlet from Vabbi that urged Elonians to freedom. Grant stability and resolution to allies while breaking stun.
The final charge of this skill is more powerful.

43565.name: Bow of Truth
43565.description: Spirit Weapon. Command the Bow of Truth to barrage a location with healing arrows.

43826.name: Searing Slash
43826.description: Unleash your searing axe in an overhand slash, following it up with a magical edge.

44080.name: Mantra of Truth
44080.description:
Mantra. Prepare the tenets of truth to debilitate your foes.
The final charge of this skill is more powerful.

44248.name: Clarified Conclusion
44248.description: Final Charge. Recite the concluding passage, converting corruption into enhancements for your allies and aiding them in recovery.

44364.name: Tome of Justice
44364.description:
Virtue: Burn foes every few attacks.
Activate: Pull forth a magical tome on the dangers of the blazing heat in Kourna.

44602.name: Bleeding Edge
44602.description: Slice through your foe again, physically and magically, as your weapon is heating up.

44846.name: Sword of Justice
44846.description: Spirit Weapon. Will the Sword of Justice to appear beside your enemy and attack nearby foes.

45047.name: Core Cleave
45047.description: Cleave at your enemy with a physical and a magical axe.

45082.name: Flame Rush
45082.description: Unleash a wave of purging fire in front of and around you.

45402.name: Blazing Edge
45402.description: Conjure a magical axe to rake your enemies toward you.

45460.name: Mantra of Lore
45460.description:
Mantra. Chant the ritual of cleansing, removing conditions and speeding recovery.
The final charge of this skill is more powerful.

46148.name: Mantra of Flame
46148.description:
Mantra. Prepare a chant to sear your enemies. 
The final charge of this skill is more powerful.

46170.name: Hammer of Wisdom
46170.description: Spirit Weapon. Order the Hammer of Wisdom to knock down your foe.

50392.name: Judgment of Light
50392.description: Fire a barrage of bouncing light missiles that damage enemies and heal allies.

50399.name: Detonate Light
50399.description: Fire a ball of light that detonates on impact to heal allies and damage foes.

51645.name: Seeking Judgment
51645.description: Fire a seeking projectile that explodes upon contact and damages enemies.

51660.name: Searing Light
51660.description: Fire a projectile that explodes upon impact and damages enemies.

53482.name: Glacial Blow
53482.description: Crush nearby foes with a chilling slam. If your target has been struck by Banish, teleport to them.

62521.name: Roiling Light
62521.description: Physical. Break stun and dodge backward, blinding foes and gaining resistance. Then, gain access to Quick Retribution.

62525.name: Executioner's Calling
62525.description: Strike your foe with rending force. Follow up this attack with a dual strike that deals increased damage against foes you struck with the first.

62528.name: Willbender Flames
62528.description:
Leave a trail of flame in your wake that damage enemies.

Activating this skill destroys other active Willbender Flames effects.

62532.name: Crashing Courage
62532.description: Virtue. Shadowstep a short distance while gaining boons and emanating Willbender Flames from your location. Gain courage.

62549.name: Heel Crack
62549.description: Physical. Perform a quick heel strike that stuns your target.

62561.name: Heaven's Palm
62561.description: Physical. Evade attacks, then shadowstep and slam the ground, knocking down your targeted foe, finishing them if there are no other enemy players nearby. Foes that aren't targeted are knocked back instead.

62565.name: Whirling Light
62565.description: Physical. Lunge forward and perform a whirlwind kick, weakening and burning any foes left in your wake.

62603.name: Flowing Resolve
62603.description: Virtue. Remove conditions and gain Flowing Resolve. Rush forward and evade attacks while leaving Willbender Flames in your wake.

62608.name: Flash Combo
62608.description: Physical. Shadowstep to your target and strike at them multiple times. If the skill completes without being interrupted, gain access to Repose.

62618.name: Willbender Flames
62618.description:
Manifest flames that damage enemies on an interval.

Activating this ability destroys other active Willbender Flames effects.

62622.name: Reversal of Fortune
62622.description: Physical. Guard yourself with light, negating the next incoming strike and healing you instead, even if the strike would have been lethal. If an effect causes damage that would be lethal, that damage will be negated and you will be healed instead. If no attacks or lethal damage are negated, you will be healed for the lowest set amount.

62648.name: Crashing Courage
62648.description: Virtue. Shadowstep a short distance while gaining boons and emanating Willbender Flames from your location. Gain courage.

62650.name: Advancing Strike
62650.description: Quickly dash toward your foe and then shadowstep to deliver a debilitating attack that immobilizes your enemies.

62668.name: Rushing Justice
62668.description: Virtue. Rush toward your target and gain Justice, delivering a strike and emanating Willbender Flames.

62669.name: Repose
62669.description: Shadowstep to Flash Combo's starting point, healing and removing conditions.

62676.name: Quick Retribution
62676.description: Physical. Lunge forward and unleash a disorienting strike at your foe, dazing them.

68647.name: Tome of Justice
68647.description:
Virtue: Burn foes every few attacks.
Activate: Pull forth a magical tome on the dangers of the blazing heat in Kourna.

68648.name: Tome of Resolve
68648.description:
Virtue: Regenerate health.
Activate: Draw forth an enchanted tome that recounts the trials undergone by the people of Vabbi.

68650.name: Tome of Courage
68650.description:
Virtue: Gain aegis periodically. 
Activate: Conjure a mystic tome containing stories about the heroes of Istan.

68666.name: Renewed Focus
68666.description: Meditation. Focus, making yourself invulnerable and recharging your virtues.

68670.name: "Feel My Wrath!"
68670.description: Shout. Grant fury and quickness to nearby allies. The duration of the quickness you grant yourself is doubled.

68676.name: Signet of Courage
68676.description:
Signet Passive: Periodically heal allies in an area around you while in combat.
Signet Active: Channel healing and boons in a large area around you, concluding with a large heal if this skill is not interrupted.

68686.name: Dragon's Maw
68686.description: Trap. Lay a trap that pulls enemies and creates a barrier that holds them in.

71798.name: Lesser Litany of Wrath
71798.description: Meditation. Heal yourself. For a brief time, heal yourself based on a percentage of damage dealt to enemies.

71817.name: Jurisdiction
71817.description: Charge up a ball of blue flame and launch it at your enemies. Enemies it hits are burned and stunned.

71918.name: Hail of Justice
71918.description: Shoot a volley of rapid-fire piercing shots that inflict bleeding and cripple.

71968.name: Peacekeeper
71968.description: Fire a beam of searing light that damages and burns all enemies in its path.

71987.name: Symbol of Ignition
71987.description: Symbol. Create a symbol that ignites when you strike an enemy inside it or shoot a projectile into it, damaging and burning enemies inside it. If the symbol is ignited by a projectile, it enchants that projectile to burn its target.

72031.name: Through the Heart
72031.description: Fire a piercing shot that inflicts bleeding.

72940.name: Helio Rush
72940.description:
Charge forward with your spear, striking enemies and healing allies you pass through. Upon striking an enemy, your next spear attack is illuminated.
 
Illuminated. Allies you pass through are healed for more and gain boons. Enemies you strike take bonus damage and are inflicted with conditions.

  Allies at full health are not affected by this skill.

72978.name: Gleaming Disc
72978.description:
Spin around, striking enemies around you. After a short delay, a shock wave of light bursts forth from your position, damaging enemies and granting might to allies. Your next spear attack is illuminated when striking an enemy with the initial spin. 

Illuminated. The shock wave additionally deals more damage and inflicts conditions on enemies and grants boons to allies.

73055.name: Daybreaking Slash
73055.description: Swing your spear, sending out a wave of light in front of you that damages enemies and heals allies.

73094.name: Solar Storm
73094.description:
Throw a spear above the targeted point. The spear explodes, raining shards that damage enemies and remove conditions from allies. Your next spear attack is illuminated if you are within range of your own shards. 

Illuminated. More shards are produced. Removing conditions from allies also heals them. 
Damage is reduced per target each time they are struck by this skill.

73132.name: Symbol of Luminance
73132.description:
Places the Symbol of Luminance on the ground, knocking back enemies on initial cast. While active, the symbol grants boons to allies and inflicts conditions on enemies. While standing within the symbol, your spear attacks are automatically illuminated and do not consume the illuminated effect when used. Resistance granted by this skill can only be granted once per interval.

Illuminated. While the symbol is active, all other spear skills are illuminated, even if you move out of range of the symbol.

76621.name: Resolute Stance
76621.description: Stance. Enter a stance that heals when you remove conditions from yourself, then heal nearby allies and remove conditions from them.

76687.name: Daring Advance
76687.description: Stance. Leap to an area, tethering nearby enemies and empowering allies. Tethered enemies are revealed and take additional damage from your attacks and are stunned if they move beyond the range threshold.

76813.name: Effulgent Stance
76813.description: Stance. Grant barrier and light aura to nearby allies, then enter a stance that charges up a burst of light when striking or struck by enemies. The burst of light dazes enemies if fully charged.

77073.name: Enter Radiant Forge
77073.description: Enter Radiant Forge. The recharge time of this skill is reduced for each unused radiant weapon in shroud.

77078.name: Piercing Stance
77078.description: Stance. Enter a stance that causes you to deal more damage, then strike nearby enemies to daze them.

77164.name: Sovereign of Light
77164.description: Your light aura detonates, damaging nearby foes and healing nearby allies.

77300.name: Valorous Stance
77300.description: Stance. Enter a stance that causes you to heal allies when you grant them boons, then grant boons to nearby allies.

77321.name: Stalwart Stance
77321.description: Stance. Break stun for nearby allies and enter a defensive stance, taking reduced damage.

78358.name: Radiant Courage
78358.description:
Virtue: Gain aegis periodically.
Activate: Grant aegis, resistance, and Luminary's Blessing to yourself and nearby allies. 
The next time you use Gleaming Blade, it deals increased damage and immobilizes enemies. The next time you use Radiant Bulwark, it grants barrier to nearby allies.

78514.name: Radiant Resolve
78514.description:
Virtue: Regenerates health.
Activate: Heal yourself and nearby allies while granting light aura. The next time you use Luminous Staff, it heals allies and grants them regeneration.

78604.name: Radiant Resolve
78604.description:
Virtue: Regenerates health.
Activate: Heal yourself and nearby allies while granting light aura. The next time you use Luminous Staff, it heals allies and grants them regeneration.

78770.name: Radiant Courage
78770.description:
Virtue: Gain aegis periodically.
Activate: Grant aegis, resistance, and Luminary's Blessing to yourself and nearby allies. 
The next time you use Gleaming Blade, it deals increased damage and immobilizes enemies. The next time you use Radiant Bulwark, it grants barrier to nearby allies.

78837.name: Radiant Justice
78837.description:
Virtue: Burn foes every few attacks.
Activate: Gain quickness. The next time you use Dazzling Hammer, it creates a delayed secondary impact.

79336.name: Lesser Symbol of Blades
79336.description: Symbol. Create a mystic symbol, damaging foes and granting boons to allies.
